A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DecHOI research work, including the main paper and supplementary Sections A–J. Text, equations, tables, and figures are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, DynaPlan experiments, ablations, runtime measurements, and a 200-participant user study.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in the main paper and supplementary material.

M1.justification: The trajectory/action generators, cross-attention conditioning, distal-joint adversarial training, reconstruction guidance, and DynaPlan procedure are unchanged in Section 3 and supplementary Sections A, C, and D.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate FullBodyManipulation, unseen 3D-FUTURE objects, and Replica-based DynaPlan scenarios. No dataset, task, population, or test scenario coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Main Table 1 retains Lin-OMOMO, Pred-OMOMO, CHOIS, and HOIFHLI; Table 2 retains the OMOMO variants and CHOIS. Comparator membership also matches in the DynaPlan, user-study, and supplementary experiments.

E3.justification: The subject split, metrics, training settings, waypoint conditions, approximately 190 DynaPlan scenarios, and user-study design are unchanged. Supplementary protocol details also match.

E4.justification: Main Table 4 and supplementary Sections E–F retain the same component ablations, generator-weight sensitivity, privileged-waypoint comparison, oracle-trajectory experiment, and loss-landscape analysis. The qualitative case studies also match.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates and user-study proportions without seed specifications, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and qualitative findings match throughout both PDFs. For example, DecHOI's main Table 1 FID remains 0.33 and MPJPE 15.27; Figure 8 retains text-alignment preferences of 71.5% against CHOIS and 67.5% against HOIFHLI.

T1.justification: The diffusion, loss, and guidance equations and supplementary metric, risk-map, and path-cost formulations are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about decoupled generation, improved contact, removal of manual intermediate waypoints, dynamic replanning, and benchmark performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the experimental results and metric trade-offs are unchanged. Supplementary Section J retains the limitations concerning rigid objects, a single manipulated object, and a single moving obstacle.

D1.justification: The new acknowledgement discloses NVIDIA Academic Grant support using an RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q Workstation Edition. This is limited hardware-support information: Supplementary Section A still specifies the same RTX 3090 experimental setup and approximately 25 GPU hours, without establishing any hardware replacement or rerun.

R1.justification: The related-work discussions, research positioning, and cited works in both reference lists are unchanged. The main references merely reflow after the added acknowledgement.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Acknowledgement section before the main references and updates the arXiv version/date text. The scientific prose and main and supplementary section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 removes printed page-number footers and reflows the main references around the acknowledgement. The figures, tables, captions, plotted evidence, and qualitative examples retain the same content and organization.

improvement.justification: The method, experimental evidence, analyses, and limitations are unchanged across the main paper and appendices. Added funding and hardware-support attribution and minor layout adjustments do not materially change the paper's scientific support, clarity, or reproducibility.
